value.title: Deja vu
value.synopsis: A young boy decides to join a secret paramilitary organization, Spirits, in order to avoid school and follow some cute recruiter chick. His adopted sister gets mad and joins Spirits out of pure spite and jealousy.

value.title: The Fire of Chandaly
value.synopsis: Two friends, Kei and Naoki, join Spirits to help save mankind and become Devadasy's pilots.
